class.name: trossen_arm_controllers/GravityCompensationController
class.description: Controller for the Trossen Arm that does gravity compensation by sending zero external effort commands.

class.name: trossen_arm_controllers/CartesianPositionController
class.description: Controller for commanding Trossen Arm Cartesian tool-tip positions through ros2_control.

class.description: Controller for commanding Trossen Arm Cartesian tool-tip external forces and torques through ros2_control.

class.description: Controller for signaling emergency stop engage and release commands to the Trossen Arm hardware interface.
